sv.title: Han gjorde Nvidia till AI-boomens bank
sv.summary: NEW YORK. Under Jensen Huang blev Nvidia en central aktör i AI-boomen – som chipleverantör, finansiär och politisk maktfaktor. Bolaget investerade i sina egna kunder, samtidigt som Jensen Huang byggde relationer ända in i Vita huset.

en.title: He made Nvidia the bank of the AI boom
en.summary: NEW YORK. Under Jensen Huang, Nvidia became a central player in the AI boom – as chip supplier, financier and political power factor. The company invested in its own customers, while Jensen Huang built relationships all the way into the White House.
